PLC Singapore · AI says:

Yes, damaged items are handled a bit differently from a regular return.

Damaged / wrong / defective / expired items: We can arrange an exchange if you contact us within 7 days of delivery/purchase. Items must be returned unused, in original packaging, with proof of purchase. For items with a “Quality Guarantee” on the packaging, we also review claims (with at least 50% of the product remaining) case‑by‑case.
Normal returns (change of mind, etc.): All items are strictly non‑refundable, but unopened items with unopened packaging can be exchanged within 7 days from purchase/delivery for other items.

So in short: both are exchanges only (no refunds), but damaged/defective/guarantee items are specifically covered for replacement based on condition and our 7‑day exchange policy, while normal returns are only allowed if completely unopened and within 7 days.
